modalities.evidence: structural T1-weighted and functional magnetic resonance brain imaging data
fMRI version of Monetary Incentive Delay task (MID) was used

output.population: 37 men (aged 20-30), excluding self-reported psychiatric or neurological history and current medication use
output.summary: Structural and functional MRI from men performing a Monetary Incentive Delay task, with questionnaires on eveningness, distinctness, sleep quality, personality, anxiety, reward and punishment sensitivity, and attention deficits.
